name.value: Canlan Ice Sports Langley Twin Rinks

description.value: Canlan Ice Sports Langley Twin Rinks is a twin-sheet ice facility operated by Canlan Sports, one of Canada's largest private ice sports operators. The venue hosts recreational skating, hockey drop-ins, leagues, camps, tournaments, and birthday parties. A touring cyclist in Langley could use it as a recreational stop or a rainy-day indoor activity.
